Kleano app design

The customer and biker apps for on-demand car washing, redesigned for iPhone and Android in English and Arabic. Screens below come from the running apps, as of 31 October 2026. Account details are masked.

PrinciplesColoursTypeComponentsCustomer appBiker appAll pagesSpeed

Principles

  • Each platform feels native: iPhone follows Apple's conventions and Android follows Material 3 for colour, type, fields and dialogs.
  • Glass is only for navigation: the tab bar, back and top-bar buttons, and controls floating over a map. Content, sheets and dialogs stay solid and easy to read.
  • iPhone uses Apple's real Liquid Glass. Android uses a Flutter-drawn glass tuned to stay light on the device.
  • Purple means action. One main button per screen.
  • The app keeps its own icons, photos and wording.

Colours

These are the iPhone values, with the dark values prepared for later. Android keeps the same brand purple with its own fixed neutrals: background #F6F6F7, surface #FFFFFF, text #1B1B1D, secondary text #5C5C62, error #C4161C. Selected items use a soft purple tint, #ECE6EF.

Type

System fonts only: SF Pro and SF Arabic on iPhone, Roboto and Noto Arabic on Android. Text follows the phone's size setting.

StyleiPhoneAndroidUsed for
Large title34 / bold32 / semiboldGreeting, screen titles
Title22 / bold22 / mediumSection titles
Headline17 / semibold16 / mediumCard titles, buttons
Body1716Main text
Subhead1514Secondary details
Footnote1312Labels, metadata
Caption1211Small print

Spacing steps are 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24 and 32. Corner radii are 14 for fields, 22 for cards, 30 for dialogs and 34 for sheets. Tap targets are at least 44 points.

Customer app

Home

Address first, any wash in progress next, then the service choice. Offers sit below the task and no longer move by themselves.

Service selected

Extras appear only after a wash is chosen, and the button shows the running total.

Car, time, location and notes, then extras, in one scroll.

Saved cars with photo, plate and colour.

Active, history and scheduled washes, with a clear status on each.

Plans

Subscription plans, each keeping its own colour. Tap to expand.

Biker app

Four tabs: Today, Orders, Earnings and Profile.

Today

The online switch comes first, then the current job with call and WhatsApp, then washes, rating and earnings.

Earnings

All-time earnings first, then today, weekends and completed washes.

Profile

Status and analytics, then schedule, personal information, settings and about.

Schedule

Each day's time slots with the area and shift.

Notifications

New orders with a time and an unread dot.

All pages

Status of every area. All areas are on the new design system. "Device review pending" means the screen has not yet been checked on a phone after the redesign.

Speed

  • Customer app images and assets went from 28 MB to 8 MB by removing unused photos.
  • Fixed waits removed at launch: splash (2.5 s), address check (2.3 s) and Home services (2 s).
  • Images load at the size shown, and lists no longer run an animated placeholder on every card.
  • The offers banner no longer runs a timer, and glass panes share one blur pass.

These are changes to the code. Timings on real phones have not been measured yet.
